ResearchProjectDef.label: Ancient drone control
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reconstruct the neural command architecture, targeting logic and expendable guided drones used by precursor control systems. Requires analysis of a fractured original Ancient drone core; recovered originals are not safe ammunition. Unlocks the Ancient control chair, costly stable reconstructed drones, and the armed-command upgrade that lets a player Puddle Jumper launch real reconstructed drones carried in its cargo.
